Name: TV Shopping channel
Author: Tomokisan1
Description:
Add a TV shopping channel, that appear given days and let you buy stacks of random product at a variable price (explanation below).

Features :

-Appear given days of week, default to Sunday, configurable.
-Let you choose between x and y different stack of items, the stack size is random between a range, all is configurable, default to between 2 and 5 items, stack size between 1 and 50.
-One item per day, the channel disappear for the rest of the day after a purchase, choose wisely.
-Items are sold at their in-game native purchase price multiplied by a random multiplier between 0.85 - 1.25, this is not configurable (for a given reason)
-If an item has a in game purchase price of 0, the mod assign to it a price derived from it's caracteristics to be as fair as possible.
-Come translated in English and French + it can be translated easily via the translation.json file in the assets folder of the mod !

Future features :

-Add a book to decrease the range of the mentioned price multiplier and so in fact increase the chances of buying at a good price.
-Maybe your suggestion ? Don't hesitate !


All configurable features are via the ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod.
